objective: Develop FusionBench for publication as a general library and benchmark for prediction fusion. Its contributions are controlled datasets, parameterized and seeded generators, accessible reference data and a documented scenario API that researchers can extend. Maintain a clear data contract and reproducible examples suitable for MkDocs. Preserve the 19 built-ins as a versioned reference suite while permitting additional scenarios. Validation-to-test transfer is one optional protocol. Use OKAPI as a diagnostic case study: show a verified improvement on independent data or characterize a scoped limitation, distinguishing representation, search and generalization. Interpretability analyses can help identify which inputs, operations and optimizations account for a result. For OKAPI experiments compare simple averaging, development-ranked prefix Top-N, and regularized logistic stacking on matched labels and predictions. Freeze comparisons before evaluation and report uncertainty, complexity and cost. Preserve existing research branches. PyPI release, website deployment and dev/main integration are separate publication steps.
